card.name: Chang Lo (Sua Lua)
card.tagline: Chang Naga victory dance of the Poanglem festival
card.profile: Chang Lo, also called Sua Lua, is a traditional folk dance of the Chang Naga tribe of Nagaland, historically performed to celebrate victory over enemies and now staged during the three-day Poanglem (Naknyulem) festival marking the harvest season (Details of India; Nagaland GK). Male dancers wear Naga warrior attire while women wear colourful traditional costumes; the dance is performed in a group with drummers, chanting, clapping and warrior-like movements, sometimes incorporating dramatic enactment. It celebrates good health, prosperity and communal unity (Details of India; TrvMe).
card.insight: No standalone English Wikipedia article exists for Chang Lo; it is documented in tribal-culture compendia and Nagaland cultural resources, consistently linked to the Chang tribe's Poanglem/Naknyulem festival.
